summary: The authors tested whether SCN gene expression oscillated within each diet. HypoExplorer estimates the common HFD-minus-chow difference in expression across matched sampling times. Review of the manuscript, all eight supplements, GEO files and public repositories found no author estimate of that difference. Both GEO input hashes matched the registered provenance. The proposal and evidence are saved, with 46 source files indexed in SOURCES.tsv.
openIssues: Reopen if the authors release signed gene-level estimates of the common diet effect for these SCN libraries, with the effect scale and time adjustment documented. Author agreement, P values and FDR for that effect remain unassessed.
The supplement names a HiSeq 2500 and GEO/ENA name a HiSeq 4000. This instrument discrepancy does not affect the contrast decision.
